ul.li: The X-Author Outlook add-in must have been installed and you are connected.
You must be a member of at least one Chatter group

step.cmd: In Outlook, click New E-mail or reply to an existing message
In the Message tab, write your email and attach any files, per usual.
Select an existing group from the Groups list

info.p: Click Search Group and select the desired group from the Groups search window.

step.cmd: Select Share with Group to take the text of your email body and insert it as a chatter feed entry.

info.p: Select Share with Group and Entire Message to insert the text of the email into the chatter feed, while
also attaching the whole message (email + any attachments as a .msg file) to that chatter feed entry.

result.p: The file is now attached to the draft email.

postreq.p: You can repeat the task to attach another file or send the email.
